exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to keep one's balance, to remain on one's feet, to stand one's ground, to stand fast
stand (a device to hold something upright or aloft)
to defend, to protect, to hold against enemy attacks
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: устоя́ть — to keep one's balance, to remain on one's feet, to stand one's ground, to stand fast; сто́йка — stand (a device to hold something upright or aloft); отстоя́ть — to defend, to protect, to hold against enemy attacks; настоя́ние — insistence, insisting.
